rules: real-world nonoccurrence => admitted_absence + admitted four-gate assessment; other types forbidden for that truth condition
attributed belief/appraisal about absence != established nonoccurrence
participant correction => append-only successor with correction provenance + immediate supersedes_fact_id; no mutation/branching; only unique current leaf projects
fact-specific source qualification/uncertainty stays attached and projects
temporal_relation requires source support; fixed behavior vocabulary not required
failed/unclear absence cannot damage positive facts
immutable relative to first thread proposal
only pre_first_proposal can be preproposal anchor/counterexample
later/unclear evidence cannot be promoted or treated as unbiased recurrence evidence
>=1 grounding link for every terminal-capable proposal: pre_first_proposal + preproposal_anchor + current admissible fact + supports current proposition
grounding subset of evidence; revisions append-only
episode facts stay episode-level; adapters may not derive person-level recurrence/typicality/frequency/trait/pattern by aggregation/counting/clustering/scoring/summarizing
person-level recurrence/typicality only from accepted resolved_pattern

invariants: open-world facts without fixed category/Other Specified
post-first-proposal examples are selected scope evidence
